jobs.originalTitle: [Summer 2027] TSMC AZ Internship Opportunities - Engineering Roles
responsibilitiesZh: 覆盖制程整合、良率、制程、设备、智能制造、AMHS、质量、产品、光罩、工具安装、安全与 CIM 等多个实习方向
在先进晶圆厂环境中使用数据分析、系统化排障、自动化、监控或机器学习方法改进生产
以跨团队协作为基础完成十周全职现场项目并汇报成果
responsibilitiesEn: Covers internship tracks in process integration, yield, process, equipment, intelligent manufacturing, AMHS, quality, product, mask, tool install, safety, and CIM
Uses data analysis, systematic troubleshooting, automation, observability, or machine learning to improve advanced-fab operations
Completes a ten-week full-time on-site project with cross-functional collaboration and presentation
minimumQualificationsZh: 就读于受认可大学的相关本科、硕士或博士项目
能够在 2027 年指定日期于 Phoenix 现场全职工作十周
具备主动学习、协作、沟通、计算机与展示能力
minimumQualificationsEn: Currently enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD program at an accredited university
Able to work full-time on site in Phoenix for ten weeks during one of the specified Summer 2027 windows
Demonstrates self-directed learning, collaboration, communication, computing, and presentation skills
eligibilityZh: 申请人必须在美国具有合法工作资格
岗位可能接触出口管制技术数据，非美国人士可能需要出口许可
是否可由 F-1 CPT 满足要求必须在申请前向招聘方逐岗确认
eligibilityEn: Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States
Roles may involve export-controlled technical data, and non-U.S. persons may require an export license
Whether F-1 CPT satisfies the requirement must be confirmed with recruiting for the exact track before applying

compensation.sourceTitle: [Summer 2027] TSMC AZ Internship Opportunities - Engineering Roles
compensation.notesZh: 官方岗位页在观察日未披露现金薪资区间；页面说明可提供搬迁协助
compensation.notesEn: The official posting did not disclose a cash-pay range on the observation date; it stated that relocation assistance is available

responsibilitiesZh: 设计、制造并表征超导量子比特及相关器件
改进制造工艺以提升量子比特相干性与可重复性
在稀释制冷机等低温测试环境中开发量子比特控制与测量硬件
responsibilitiesEn: Designs, builds, and characterizes superconducting qubits and related devices
Develops fabrication processes that improve qubit coherence and reproducibility
Builds qubit-control and measurement hardware in cryogenic environments including dilution refrigerators
minimumQualificationsZh: 物理、电气工程或相关专业本科、硕士或博士学位
三年以上量子硬件或相近研发环境经验
具备超导量子比特、低温测量、器件制造或相关量子技术经验
能够在 Madison 现场工作
minimumQualificationsEn: BS, MS, or PhD in physics, electrical engineering, or a related field
Three or more years of experience in quantum hardware or a similar R&D environment
Experience with superconducting qubits, cryogenic measurement, device fabrication, or related quantum technologies
Able to work on site in Madison
eligibilityZh: 官方页面未披露签证赞助或出口管制条件，申请前需要逐项确认
eligibilityEn: The official page did not disclose visa sponsorship or export-control terms; both require posting-specific confirmation

compensation.notesZh: 官方岗位页在观察日未披露基本工资、奖金或股权区间
compensation.notesEn: The official posting did not disclose base salary, bonus, or equity ranges on the observation date
